message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy for re-engagement by extending east in level, accelerating flight, maintaining growing lateral separation from B0100 and the missiles trailing to its northwest rather than turning back toward the fight.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate the inbound missile geometry by sustaining a fast, descending, high-bank turn toward east, given the B-team missiles to its north and the newly launched B0100 missile continuing to close from the northwest."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy for re-engagement by extending east in level, accelerating flight, maintaining growing lateral separation from B0100 and the missiles trailing to its northwest rather than turning back toward the fight.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate the inbound missile geometry by sustaining a fast, descending, high-bank turn toward east, given the B-team missiles to its north and the newly launched B0100 missile continuing to close from the northwest.
